findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "HIMPUNAN MAHASISWA SISTEM Komputer." → 4 lines (4 words, 136.1px); "RUANG TUMBUH, BUKAN SEKADAR tempat kumpul." → 3 lines (6 words, 60.5px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 6 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 9 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "STEKOM · Periode 2026/2027" (pill) above "HIMPUNAN MAHASISWA SISTEM Komputer."; "Anggota aktif" above "180+"; "Divisi & biro" above "12"; "Program kerja" above "40+"; "Tahun berkarya" above "9"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: JetBrains Mono — e.g. "Himpunan Mahasiswa", "STEKOM · Periode 2026/2027", "Satu himpunan · Banyak jalur berkarya", "Himpunan Mahasiswa"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01 — Tentang kami", "02 — Divisi", "01", "02", "03", "04"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 49 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "STEKOM · Periode 2026/2027", "Satu himpunan · Banyak jalur berkarya", "Himpunan Mahasiswa", "Sistem Komputer").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 9 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.mt-10.grid 1216px | div.marquee.relative 1440px | dl.grid.grid-cols-2 1216px | div.reveal.flex 1216px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 14 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 1 dashed/dotted border(s).
findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: 3 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (3, 6, 3 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (section #f5f2ea).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: 4 typefaces in use (ui-sans-serif, JetBrains Mono, Bricolage Grotesque, Instrument Serif).
findings.fix: Two at most: one display, one text. Often one is enough.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 28 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The margins differ: 112px on the left, 128px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 30% of the first screen is one empty block (540×720px at 900,120).
findings.fix: Place the void on purpose or fill it: move the picture, the film or one fact into it, grow the headline to meet it, or shrink the screen to its content. A void reads as placed only when something closes it on the far side and it is the screen's one rest.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 12 different lines (112px, 137px, 546px, 956px, 148px, 736px, 944px); the three most used hold only 55% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Little motion: 11 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Give every section an entrance for its parts (not one fade of the whole block) and add one moving picture: a looping clip or a slow move on a photograph.
